definitions.explanation: A fundamental property of matter that causes it to experience electromagnetic force. Comes in positive and negative forms, with interactions between charges producing electricity, magnetism, and electromagnetic radiation.

⟦{静電気|せいでんき}→静電気：18522_seidenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物体|ぶったい}→物体：13506_buttai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{電荷|でんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまること⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Static electricity occurs when electric charge accumulates on the surface of an object.

notes:
Compound of {電|でん} ('electricity') and {荷|か} ('load; cargo; charge'). The fundamental physics term for the quantity of electricity carried by a particle or body. Encountered in high school physics education and technical contexts.

USAGE:
- A core concept in physics: ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電荷|でんか} ('positive charge') and ⟦{負|ふ}→負：09512_fu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電荷|でんか} ('negative charge').
- The SI unit of electric charge is the coulomb (クーロン).
- Also used in chemistry when discussing ions: an ion is an atom that has gained or lost {電荷|でんか}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電荷|でんか}: positive charge
- ⟦{負|ふ}→負：09512_fu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電荷|でんか}: negative charge
- {電荷|でんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{帯|お}びる→帯びる：12428_obiru⟧: to carry a charge; to become charged
- {電荷|でんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧: conservation of charge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電流|でんりゅう}→電流：21016_denryuu⟧: electric current — the flow of electric charge through a conductor
- ⟦{電圧|でんあつ}→電圧：19996_denatsu⟧: voltage — the difference in electric potential that drives current
- ⟦{静電気|せいでんき}→静電気：18522_seidenki⟧: static electricity — stationary electric charge on a surface
- ⟦{帯電|たいでん}→帯電：21702_taiden⟧: electrification; becoming charged — the process of acquiring an electric charge
